Historical successes show that fold-train-only smoothed target statistics, decorrelated-but-strong learners, and a complete persisted bundle are what reliably move tabular accuracy; historical failures were almost always fold-ownership leakage or refit-on-predict bugs, not representation gaps. Therefore the most promising refinements are the feature block (occupation/coupon×occupation target encoding, missingness flags, coupon-context interactions), the booster ensemble definition, and the OOF/persistence wiring that keeps the pipeline load-only at inference.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "model_design", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Extend the feature-engineering stage with three leakage-safe additions to the existing build_features path: (1) smoothed target encoding for occupation and the coupon×occupation interaction using encoded = (sum_y + prior*m)/(count + m) with m=20 and a global training prior, (2) explicit was_missing binary indicator flags for Bar, CoffeeHouse, CarryAway, RestaurantLessThan20 and Restaurant20To50, and (3) a coupon_group × distance_bucket interaction plus an interest-match score comparing the user's coffee-house/bar frequency ordinal against the coupon's venue type. WHY: 25-way one-hot occupation sparsifies tree splits and the real signal is the conditional occupation×coupon acceptance rate, so a shrunk prior compresses that into one smooth dimension; the 70–127-row missing pattern in the five FREQ columns is not random and currently discarded; the coupon-context interactions encode the domain logic that a coupon is accepted when destination and user preference align. HOW: keep build_features(df, ohe=None, fit=False) as the public signature, add fit_target_encoding(train_df, y_train, fold_ids, m=20) and transform_target_encoding(df) methods/state on the engineer object so category maps, prior, m and te_col_names serialize with the bundle; during CV each fold must call fit_target_encoding on that fold's TRAIN rows only and transform both train and validation rows with those maps, while the final fit uses all training rows; unseen/NaN categories fall back to the stored prior and the existing feature_names/reindex/NaN-fill ordering contract is preserved.", "model_design": "WHAT: Replace the current three-family simplex (HGB + ExtraTrees + LGBM, fixed max_iter=400 at lr=0.06) with a seed-bagged ensemble of the two strongest families, HistGradientBoosting and LightGBM, each trained at a lower learning rate (~0.03) with more iterations, early stopping driven by the internal CV, and 3 seeds per family; drop ExtraTrees because it dilutes blend weight on this 21-feature categorical set. WHY: the initial plan targets variance reduction, and historical runs show ExtraTrees mostly matches or trails the boosters on this data while splitting blend weight, whereas lower-lr boosting with more rounds and seed bagging is a better bias-variance trade; the new occupation/coupon×occupation target-encoded columns and missingness/interaction flags should be fed to both families so their residuals stay comparably informative without correlated over-smoothing. HOW: keep _make_models(seed, n_classes), _fit_predict(model, X_tr, y_tr, X_te, n_classes) and build_features signatures unchanged; inside _make_models set HGB to learning_rate~0.03, max_iter>=800, early_stopping=True with validation_fraction 0.15 and n_iter_no_change~40, and LGBMClassifier to learning_rate~0.03, n_estimators>=1200 with early stopping and n_jobs=2; assemble the design matrix as one-hot plain categoricals + ordinal numerics + interaction/missing-flag block + TE block in a fixed column order, explicitly excluding TE columns from any leakage-sensitive extra path, and ensure constructor names and MODEL_CFG-style constants remain compatible with existing call sites.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Switch blend-weight selection from a single 5-fold StratifiedKFold pass to 5-fold stratified CV repeated 3 times with seed 42, collecting OOF probabilities for every seed-bagged HGB/LGB member and scoring simplex weights plus early-stopping rounds on the repeated-CV OOF using plain accuracy on original labels; refit chosen members on all training rows afterward. WHY: the current single-pass OOF accuracy has roughly ±0.7% noise at 8k rows, so blend weights and early-stopping choices are fit to that noise and the blend gain disappears; repeated CV gives stable weight estimation at negligible extra cost, and historical successes confirm that a fold-train-only fitted TE/encoder plus a final full-fit refit is the safe pattern. HOW: keep train(data_dir, model_dir), predict(data_dir, model_dir, output_path) and the argparse subcommands unchanged; in train, call fit_target_encoding per fold on TRAIN rows only for OOF, then refit TE maps on all training rows for the final bundle; persist ohe, target-encoding maps/prior/m/te_col_names, missing-flag column list, feature column order, per-member model objects with their names and seeds, blend weights, label mapping and n_classes in the existing bundle.pkl; in predict, load the bundle and only transform_target_encoding/transform paths (never fit), apply stored blend weights renormalized over available members, keep row_id = np.arange(n) in authoritative input order, map indices back through the stored original labels, and gracefully fall back to majority class if no member predicts, with no changes to the row_id,prediction output contract."}}

We need to refine the initial plan into structured JSON. Initial plan has 4 changes: seed-bagged boosting ensemble, cross-fitted target encoding of occupation and coupon×occupation, missing-value indicators and coupon-context interactions, repeated CV.

Modules: the changes span feature engineering (changes #2 partially, #3), model design (change #1, #2 encoding block), training_evaluation (change #1 seed bagging ensemble, #2 OOF wiring, #4 repeated CV).

Refine based on historical: successful experiments emphasize persistable views, fold-train-only fitting, simplex/blend via OOF, persisting all state, predict read-only. Failed experiments: refit-on-predict, fold ownership leakage, arbitrary integer codes.

We need to stay true to initial plan direction: bagged boosting (HGB/LGB) instead of ExtraTrees dilution, cross-fitted target encoding of occupation and coupon×occupation, missingness flags and interactions, repeated CV.

Module choices: 3 modules likely: data_processing_and_feature_engineering (TE + missing flags + interactions), model_design (bagged ensemble definition, matrix assembly), training_evaluation (repeated CV OOF, blend weights, persistence, predict reload).

But note: in current code there's no separate model_design module per se, but the allowed modules include it. Fine.

Let's write detailed plans.

For data_processing: add leakage-safe smoothed target encoding for occupation and coupon×occupation (m=20 smoothing, global prior), fold-train only during CV, full-train for final fit; missingness indicator flags for 5 FREQ columns; coupon_group × distance_bucket interaction and interest-match score. Preserve build_features signature? Should keep function names build_features, ohe flow; add TE state. Must not use predict data labels.

For model_design: base learners: replace 3-model simplex (hgb, et, lgb) with seed-bagged ensemble of HGB and LGB only (drop ExtraTrees per plan), tune hyperparameters (lower lr, more iterations, early stopping on internal CV), assemble feature matrix including TE columns + flagged missing + interactions, keep Model factory signatures _make_models, _fit_predict, build_features compatibility. Ensure TE excluded from any leakage in fit.

For training_evaluation: repeated stratified CV (5-fold × 3 repeats, seed 42) to build OOF; blend weights via simplex/OOF accuracy on original labels; early stopping rounds from CV; persist TE maps, prior, m, feature order, missing flags, model seeds, blend weights, threshold; predict loads read-only and applies transform_target_encoding (no refit), row_id = arange(n), maps labels back.

Need to be careful: initial plan change #1 said keep OOF blend framework but restrict candidates to strongest two families; with seed bagging. So blend weights across seeds/families. Also repeated CV for weight selection.

Also mention threshold? Current code uses argmax no threshold. Metric accuracy. Could keep argmax; initial plan doesn't mention threshold. Fine.

Let's produce JSON with 1-3 modules: choose all three. Each plan 3-5 sentences.

Reason: root cause: under-regularized single-pass models and OOF fold noise; TE of occupation/coupon×occupation captures conditional rates; historical successes show decorrelated but strong learners + fold-safe persistence matter; failures show leakage from refit-on-predict. Current 0.7512.
